subtitle: 수건·어메니티 추가요청
desc: 객실에서 하우스키핑에 수건, 생수, 어메니티를 요청하는 회화

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Hello. Could I get two extra towels, please?
turns.ko: 안녕하세요. 수건 두 장 더 부탁드려요.

turns.speaker: Housekeeping
turns.en: Of course. What's your room number?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Room 1205. Could I also have more bottled water?

turns.speaker: Housekeeping
turns.en: Sure. How many bottles would you like?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Two bottles, please. And could I get shampoo and a toothbrush?
turns.ko: 두 병 주세요. 샴푸랑 칫솔도 주실 수 있나요?

turns.speaker: Housekeeping
turns.en: Yes. I'll bring towels, water, shampoo, and a toothbrush kit.
turns.ko: 네. 수건, 생수, 샴푸, 칫솔 키트를 가져갈게요.

turns.speaker: Housekeeping
turns.en: About ten minutes. Would you like the room tidied as well?

turns.speaker: You (Traveler)
turns.en: Just the items is fine. Please leave them by the door.
turns.ko: 물품만 가져다 주세요. 문 앞에 두어 주세요.

turns.speaker: Housekeeping
turns.en: No problem. I'll knock when I arrive.

tips.en: Could I get two extra towels?
Could I also have more bottled water?
Please leave them by the door.
